headline: Updates on the Markley Data Center and citywide zoning rewrite, plus the LRTA Master Plan and 2027 goals and city partnership.
summary: The agenda covers the Markley Data Center and the zoning rewrite. It also includes the LRTA Master Plan and plans for LSC 2027 goals and city partnership.
items: Markley Data Center: update from quarterly meetings with Sustainability Division
Zoning rewrite: status, timeline, and opportunities for LSC input
Status of LSC request to invite DPD to present on zoning
LRTA Master Plan: overview of the plan and timeline
LRTA Master Plan: opportunities for public comment and LSC input
LSC 2027 goals and city partnership: role of the Council and expectations between LSC and the City
Process for inviting City Departments to present to LSC
Member recruitment and status of pending membership application
Letter from LSC to the City on Council role and support (discussion and possible vote)
Upcoming events and announcements, including the 2027 LSC meeting schedule
location: Mayor's Reception Room, City Hall, 375 Merrimack St, Lowell, MA 01852 (also live and via Zoom)
